scene_type: 2D (top-down drone view, camera looking straight down at a straight road)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
units: pixels (full resolution) and seconds; image y grows downward

camera.motion: nearly static hovering drone; slow drift. Background similarity transform frame-0 -> frame-i in scene/camera.csv
camera.note: drift is <1% of car travel; raw (cx,cy) and background-stabilised (cx_stab,cy_stab) are both in the tracks

blue_car.description: dark-blue/metallic blue car (saloon/hatch) in the LEFT lane (x ~ 537-545), driving toward the image TOP (-y)
blue_car.length_px_note: clean-mask bumper-to-bumper length = 73-74 px in frames 0-85 (sunlit, reliable); 77-78 px in frames 109-127 after the tree (darker, mask probably includes a little blur/rear lights) - use 74
blue_car.approx_motion_for_orientation_only: ~ -11.35 px/frame (stabilised y) over frames 0-20, ~ -11.9 to -12.0 from frame 20 on - nearly constant

white_car.description: white car in the RIGHT lane (x ~ 577-585), driving toward the image BOTTOM (+y)
white_car.length_px_note: clean-mask length median 63 (p10-p90 60-65); varies with image position: ~65-66 near top (y<350), ~60-61 around y 800-1100, ~63-65 near bottom (y>1300) - small lens/perspective effect
white_car.approx_motion_for_orientation_only: ~ +10.1 px/frame at entry slowly falling to ~ +8.8 px/frame at exit (gently decelerating)

events.event: video start, blue car already moving up at frame 0
blue car starts passing under overhanging tree (left side of road), partly/mostly hidden
white car front bumper appears at top edge
cars pass each other (centres at same image y ~ 190)
blue car front reaches top edge
blue car fully out of frame (top)
white car passes SLOW road marking (centre y ~1195)
white car front reaches bottom edge
video end, white car rear still visible at bottom

road.description: straight two-lane asphalt road running vertically through the frame

centre_line_dashes.description: white dashed centre line at x ~ 559-560

slow_marking.description: 'SLOW' painted in the right (white car's) lane, reads upside-down for downward traffic

big_tree_over_road.description: large pale-yellow leafless willow-like tree on the left verge overhanging the left lane; occludes the blue car

yellow_tree.description: bright-yellow round tree on the left verge

side_track.description: grey track/lane curving off to the left from near the road at lower left

grass_field.description: green field left of the road

woodland_and_path.description: brown/olive woodland right of the road with a thin dirt path at x ~ 900-960
